# Embedding Service API

**Base URL:** `http://localhost:8001` (internal; not exposed to end-users in production)

**Interactive explorer:** [http://localhost:8001/docs](http://localhost:8001/docs) (Swagger UI — auto-generated by FastAPI)

**ReDoc:** [http://localhost:8001/redoc](http://localhost:8001/redoc)

:::info Internal service
The Embedding Service is designed to be called only by the API Gateway. Do not expose port `8001` publicly. In production, restrict it to the internal Docker/Kubernetes network.
:::

---

## POST /api/v1/ingest

Chunk, embed, and store a document. Called by the Gateway's `POST /api/v1/ingest` endpoint.

### Request body

```json
{
  "content": "# Bali Explorer\n\nA premium holiday...",
  "source": "bali-explorer-7n.md",
  "doc_type": "markdown",
  "metadata": {}
}
```

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content` | `string` | required | Raw document text |
| `source` | `string` | required | Document identifier |
| `doc_type` | `string` | `"markdown"` | `"markdown"` or `"json"` |
| `metadata` | `object` | `{}` | Stored with every chunk for filtering |

### Response `200 OK`

```json
{ "chunks_stored": 4, "source": "bali-explorer-7n.md" }
```

### Error responses

| Status | Schema | Cause |
|---|---|---|
| `422` | `ErrorResponse` | `doc_type` is `json` but content is not valid JSON |
| `503` | `ErrorResponse` | DB connection lost or model inference error |

---

## POST /api/v1/query

Retrieve the top-N most relevant chunks for a query using two-stage retrieval.

**Stage 1:** Embed query → HNSW KNN top-K from pgvector
**Stage 2:** CrossEncoder re-rank → top-N results

### Request body

```json
{
  "query": "What beach holidays are under £2,000?",
  "top_n": 3
}
```

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | `string` | required | Natural-language search query |
| `top_n` | `integer` | `3` | Final results after re-ranking (1–20) |

### Response `200 OK`

```json
{
  "chunks": [
    {
      "id": "3f2a1b4c-...",
      "content": "Return flights from London Heathrow, 5-star beachfront resort...",
      "source": "bali-explorer-7n.md",
      "score": 4.21,
      "metadata": { "chunk_index": 1 }
    }
  ],
  "retrieval_latency_ms": 18.4,
  "rerank_latency_ms": 31.2
}
```

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `chunks[].score` | Cross-encoder relevance score (higher = more relevant; unbounded) |
| `retrieval_latency_ms` | Time for pgvector HNSW search (Stage 1) |
| `rerank_latency_ms` | Time for cross-encoder re-ranking (Stage 2) |

## GET /api/v1/packages

Return all distinct sources stored in the vector database with chunk counts.

### Response `200 OK`

```json
{
  "packages": [
    {
      "source": "bali-explorer-7n.md",
      "chunk_count": 4,
      "last_updated": "2026-03-06T14:32:11+00:00"
    }
  ],
  "total": 1
}
```

---

## DELETE /api/v1/packages/{source}

Delete all chunks for a given source. Supports path segments with `/` by using the `{source:path}` parameter.

```bash
curl -X DELETE http://localhost:8001/api/v1/packages/bali-explorer-7n.md
```

### Response `200 OK`

```json
{ "source": "bali-explorer-7n.md", "chunks_deleted": 4 }
```

```bash
curl http://localhost:8001/health
# {"status":"ok"}
```

## Model information

| Model | Role | Dimension | Size |
|---|---|---|---|
| `all-MiniLM-L6-v2` | Bi-encoder (query + doc embedding) | 384 | ~22 MB |
| `cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2` | Re-ranking scorer | — | ~66 MB |

Both models are downloaded and cached at Docker build time to eliminate cold-start latency.

To swap models, change `EMBEDDING_MODEL` and `RERANKER_MODEL` in `.env`. If you change the embedding model, also update `EMBEDDING_DIM` and re-run `db/init.sql` to recreate the HNSW index with the new dimension.
